title: Two-Day Power Shutdown to Affect Several Areas in South Kashmir - Kashmir Life
full_text:
SRINAGAR: Power supply to several areas of south Kashmir’s Kulgam district will remain affected for five hours on November 10 and 14 due to a scheduled shutdown of the 33 kV Wanpoh-Qaimoh transmission line, the Kashmir Power Distribution Corporation Limited (KPDCL) has said.
According to the Chief Engineer, Distribution, KPDCL, the shutdown will be observed from 10 am to 3 pm on both days.
The affected areas include Qaimoh, Khudwani, Redwani, Ghat, Rehpora and Matalhama, besides adjoining localities.
The shutdown has been scheduled to facilitate work on the transmission line.
